 ORDER

This is third bail application on behalf of applicant Atul Tripathi @ Murari S/o Shri Pankaj Tripathi,
in connection with Crime No.168/2021, registered at Police Station Shahpur, District Rewa (M.P.),
for offences under Sections 363, 376(d) (a) of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
Earlier bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn.
Learned counsel for the petitioner prays for withdrawal of this bail application.
